ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CredFiles = dynamic(["Login Data","Cookies","Web Data","Local State","key4.db","logins.json","cookies.sqlite"]);
let WalletPaths = dynamic([@"\Wallets\", @"\Exodus\", @"\Electrum\", @"\Solana\", @"\Metamask\", @"\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn", @"\bhghoamapcdpbohphigoooaddinpkbai", @"\.config\Solana\"]);
let NodeFromDevContext = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("Code.exe","code.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","npm.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd","npx.cmd","bash.exe","git-bash.exe","explorer.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"                              // exclude machine accts
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project NodeStart = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              NodePid = ProcessId, ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, NodeCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
NodeFromDevContext
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where FileName in~ (CredFiles)
        or FolderPath has_any (WalletPaths)
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceIdR = DeviceId,
              NodePidR = InitiatingProcessId,
              TouchedFile = strcat(FolderPath, @"\", FileName),
              FileAction = ActionType
) on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceIdR and $left.NodePid == $right.NodePidR
| where FileTime between (NodeStart .. NodeStart + 30m)              // wallet/cred access within 30m of node launch
| summarize TouchedFiles = make_set(TouchedFile, 25),
            FirstFileTime = min(FileTime), TouchCount = count()
            by NodeStart, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentName, ParentCmd, NodeCmd
| extend KillChain = "install->credential_access", Actor = "Famous Chollima (DPRK) - BeaverTail"
| order by NodeStart desc

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (RmmTools)
    | where FolderPath !has @"\Program Files"                          // unmanaged / portable copy
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              RmmName = FileName, RmmPath = FolderPath,
              InstallerCmd = ProcessCommandLine,

| join kind=inner (
    AADSignInEventsBeta

| where SignInTime between (InstallTime - 14d .. InstallTime + 14d)
| summarize RiskySignins = count(), GeoSet = make_set(Country, 10),
            IpSet = make_set(IPAddress, 10), AppSet = make_set(Application, 10),
